title: Glossary: IBM Counter Fraud Management (ICFM) 2: A Tech Support Guide
description: This IBM Counter Fraud Management (ICFM), or ICFM 2, video explains the glossary, definitions, and terms of the system.

asr.full_text: One of the most interesting things you can do, one of the most useful things you can do with the IBM Knowledge Center, is to go to the ICFM glossary. And when you do that and open it up, you will see a whole series of terms that will make understanding Counter Fraud Management a whole lot easier. So, if you haven't already been through this, I would highly recommend that you go here.

The sampled interface shows IBM Knowledge Center search results and glossary definitions for authentication, case, and encryption. No solicitation, payment request, credential request, or promised financial return is observable in the described material.
